title: HSDD automatic-run decision record
description: One line of hsdd/judgement/decisions.jsonl: a decision the orchestrator took on the owner's behalf during an unattended planning run. Appended by the orchestrator after the step's artifact commit; never edited or removed. The owner's later review of each line goes to hsdd/judgement/decision-reviews.jsonl (see $defs.review).

at.description: When the decision was taken, ISO 8601 with a zone.

step.description: The step type, aligned with TBM's verdict steps so both calibrate the same judge. setup = inputs settled before any skill ran; plan = the execution plan itself.

step_ref.description: The step id from docs/auto-run/execution-plan.md that this decision belongs to.

artifact.description: Repository path of the file the decision lands in. Null when the decision shaped a prompt rather than a file.

question.description: The question as it arose. When a skill stopped and asked, its wording verbatim.

consequence.description: What choosing it costs or buys, in one or two sentences.

chosen.description: The label of the chosen option.

why.description: The reason, in plain words, for the owner reading it cold.

evidence.description: Spec or Guide sections by number, experiment paths under docs/auto-run/experiments/, package documentation. Empty means the decision rests on judgement alone; say so in why.

blast_radius.description: node-local: one node's internals. contract: a contract's interface or guarantees, so every consumer. tree: which nodes or contracts exist. upstream: the Specification itself would change.

would_have_asked.description: True when a skill stopped for a human, or a careful engineer would have put this to the owner before proceeding.

stop_class.description: Set when would_have_asked is true: the kind of stop that was answered on the owner's behalf. A collision, breaking-amend or external stop is never answered; it ends the run with STOP.md instead.

would_upstream.description: True when the right resolution is a change to the reference architecture; the decision is then resolved locally and listed in REPORT.md for upstreaming.

commit.description: The commit holding the artifact the decision landed in. Filled when the ledger line is written, after that commit.

review.title: Owner's review of one decision
review.description: One line of hsdd/judgement/decision-reviews.jsonl, appended by the owner at review time. A second review of the same decision is a new line.
agree: the owner would have decided the same. disagree: a different option, stated in reason. should-have-asked: the run should have stopped here regardless of the option chosen.

reason.description: Required for disagree and should-have-asked, in the owner's words.
